rules.trigger_condition: No board evaluation data shared by end of Phase 1 (approximately 8 weeks from kick-off)
rules.recommended_action: Escalate to engagement sponsor; offer an alternative aggregated assessment approach; document the data gap as a risk to diagnostic quality.

rules.trigger_condition: Diversity baseline data remains incomplete after Phase 1 discovery (missing director attributes or stale data)
rules.recommended_action: Trigger the two-source validation; extend discovery; flag low-confidence metrics in the benchmark report.

rules.trigger_condition: Board chair or nomination committee chair unavailable for the scheduled elite interview
rules.recommended_action: Re-prioritise access with the sponsor; offer alternative senior informants; record the access risk if it persists.

rules.trigger_condition: The diversity policy document has not been updated within the last 12 months
rules.recommended_action: Flag policy staleness in the diagnostic; prioritise a policy refresh in Phase 3; confirm reporting implications.

rules.trigger_condition: A FTSE 350/250 diversity target date (e.g. Parker, FTSE Women Leaders) is approaching with a quantified gap still open
rules.recommended_action: Model the trajectory required to close the gap; raise with the nomination committee; prepare a comply-or-explain narrative.

rules.trigger_condition: Board diversity metrics show no measurable improvement over two consecutive reporting periods (~6 months)
rules.recommended_action: Diagnose causes (pipeline, process, vacancies); re-baseline targets or accelerate refresh; report variance to sponsor.

rules.trigger_condition: Glass cliff indicators detected (diverse appointment into crisis, shrinking board, elevated turnover, recent profit warning)
rules.recommended_action: Review appointment context; ensure support structures; prepare honest messaging; consider postponing or restructuring the role.

rules.trigger_condition: A nomination committee meeting is skipped, postponed, or held without the agreed process/documentation
rules.recommended_action: Confirm process compliance; require criteria documentation; escalate to chair if the pattern repeats.

rules.trigger_condition: Candidate pipeline diversity ratio falls below the agreed target threshold for two consecutive cycles
rules.recommended_action: Review search firm sourcing; widen channels; assess pipeline breadth; adjust target timeframe if structural.

rules.trigger_condition: Board effectiveness score declines over consecutive evaluation periods
rules.recommended_action: Investigate drivers (dynamics, information quality); link remediation to roadmap; brief the chair.

rules.trigger_condition: Client decides not to publish diversity data in the annual report against recommendation
rules.recommended_action: Reiterate disclosure obligations and investor expectations; document the decision and rationale; warn of comply-or-explain and reputational exposure.

rules.trigger_condition: A regulatory change is announced mid-engagement that affects targets or disclosure
rules.recommended_action: Run a regulatory impact assessment; re-sequence the roadmap; communicate implications to the board and sponsor.

rules.trigger_condition: Key board sponsor departs the board or disengages during the engagement
rules.recommended_action: Re-confirm mandate with successor within one cycle; identify a co-sponsor; re-scope if commitment has changed.

rules.trigger_condition: Board refresh rate is below the level needed to build diversity (insufficient vacancies over the horizon)
rules.recommended_action: Model required vacancies vs planned retirements; stagger tenure; align refresh with succession framework.

rules.trigger_condition: Policy adoption deadline is approaching (within one board cycle of the AGM) without board action
rules.recommended_action: Front-load legal review; secure a board slot; prepare an interim resolution; warn of a one-year disclosure slip.

rules.trigger_condition: Baseline data validation reveals a discrepancy rate greater than 5% across sources
rules.recommended_action: Hold for clarification before benchmarking; resolve discrepancies; re-baseline if material.

rules.trigger_condition: A draft external disclosure contradicts or overstates validated internal diversity data (greenwashing signal)
rules.recommended_action: Reconcile disclosure to internal data; route through legal review; correct before lodgement.

rules.trigger_condition: A diversity target miss occurs with no comply-or-explain narrative prepared
rules.recommended_action: Draft a transparent explanation with remediation plan and revised trajectory before publication.

rules.trigger_condition: Intersectional (gender x ethnicity) data is still unavailable by the start of Phase 2 benchmarking
rules.recommended_action: Report available dimensions with explicit caveats; add a data-improvement plan into Phase 5 infrastructure.

rules.trigger_condition: Executive search shortlists return homogeneous candidates (no diverse slate) for two consecutive vacancies
rules.recommended_action: Review search firm sourcing; require diverse slates; supplement with additional firms or direct sourcing.

rules.trigger_condition: KPI dashboard is not live by the end of Phase 6
rules.recommended_action: Prioritise dashboard deployment; use interim manual reporting; resolve data infrastructure blockers.

rules.trigger_condition: Annual report lodgement deadline is approaching with the diversity disclosure incomplete
rules.recommended_action: Prioritise mandatory disclosure; automate data packs; de-scope non-essential content; brief auditors.

rules.trigger_condition: Director tenure clusters above the 9-year independence threshold with no refresh or re-assessment plan
rules.recommended_action: Trigger independence reassessment; integrate into succession and refresh planning; disclose treatment.

rules.trigger_condition: Mentorship or sponsorship programme participation falls below the agreed participation threshold
rules.recommended_action: Recruit senior champions; reduce friction to join; nudge participants; review programme design.

rules.trigger_condition: A proxy advisor issues or signals an adverse voting recommendation on board composition or diversity
rules.recommended_action: Engage the advisor; check thresholds and disclosure; align commitments ahead of the AGM.

rules.trigger_condition: A woman is appointed to the Chair role during a profit warning, board shrinkage, or elevated turnover (specific glass-cliff pattern)
rules.recommended_action: Review the appointment context; ensure strong support and mentorship; prepare honest external messaging.
